notes.title: Minor Patch: Bug Fixes, Balancing & Optimization
notes.content: [p]Greetings, Necromancers![/p][p][/p][p]This minor update includes several important fixes and improvements to enhance your experience in [i]The Last Sanctum[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]⚙️ [u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed two previously unusable characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected incorrect visual and sound effects for certain skills.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ [u]Balancing[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustments have been made to the stats and performance of several skills and items to improve overall game balance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 [u]General Improvements[/u][/h3][list][*][p]Minor bugs have been addressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization work has been carried out to improve performance and stability.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and support. Stay tuned for more updates — and as always, may your summons never miss their mark![/p][p][/p][p]— [i]The Last Sanctum[/i] Dev Team[/p]
